message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when someone goes “Uno.” | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (1–9, two of each; 2× “Skip”, “Reverse”, “Draw Two”; 4× “Wild”, 4× “Wild Draw Four”). | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit clockwise. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Play proceeds clockwise unless a “Reverse” changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard. If you can’t play, you must draw one card. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players (number cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50). | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins. You can also play a “short‑game” variant: first to 200, 300, etc. | | **House Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” to be stacked on top of each other instead of being challenged.
• **No “Wild Draw Four” challenge** – simply play it whenever you want.
• **“Skip” on “Skip”** – some groups let a “Skip” cancel a previous “Skip.”
• **“Draw Two” on “Draw Two”** – similar to stacking. | | **Common Etiquette** | • Keep your hand hidden from others.
• Don’t reveal your “UNO” call until you’re sure you’re the last card.
• Respect the chosen house rules before starting. | --- ### Quick Play‑through Example 1. **Deal**: 7 cards each, flip top card → 5 Red. 2. **Player A** (first) has 5 Blue → plays 5 Blue. 3. **Player B** has 5 Yellow → plays 5 Yellow. 4. **Player C** has 5 Red → plays 5 Red. 5. **Player D** has 5 Green → plays 5 Green. 6. **Player A** has 5 Blue again → plays 5 Blue. 7. **Player B** has no 5 or Blue → draws a card. 8. … and so on until someone discards their last card. Enjoy!
